articles.title: Configure SAML single sign-on
articles.body: Set the Entity ID and the ACS URL in your identity provider exactly as shown under Settings > SSO. An 'invalid audience' error means the Entity ID in the IdP does not match. After changing IdP, upload the new signing certificate.

articles.title: Export invoices in bulk
articles.body: Go to Billing > Invoices, filter by date range and choose Export > PDF archive. Archives over 500 invoices are emailed as a download link.

articles.title: Rotate a webhook signing secret
articles.body: When you rotate a signing secret, both the old and the new secret are valid for 24 hours. Receivers that verify signatures must accept the new secret; a 401 from your endpoint usually means the receiver still checks the old one or computes the signature over a modified body.

articles.title: Webhook retry schedule
articles.body: Failed webhook deliveries are retried 8 times with exponential backoff over about 24 hours. After the last retry the event is marked failed and can be redelivered from the dashboard.

articles.title: Use an authenticator app for two-factor
articles.body: Under Profile > Security choose Authenticator app and scan the QR code. SMS remains available as a fallback unless an admin disables it.

articles.title: API rate limits
articles.body: The REST API allows 10 requests per second per token with bursts up to 600 requests. Responses carry RateLimit headers; on 429, wait for the time in Retry-After.

articles.title: How seats are counted
articles.body: Billing counts every user who is not deactivated, including invited users who have not accepted. Remove pending invitations under Admin > Users to lower the seat count.

articles.title: Reset a password
articles.body: Password reset links expire after 30 minutes. After a reset, sessions on other devices are signed out. If the new password is rejected, check that the account is not managed by SSO and that caps lock is off.

articles.title: Import CSV files
articles.body: Imports accept UTF-8 CSV. Turn on Strict CSV in the import profile when fields contain quoted newlines or commas. Import errors name the row that failed; fix that row and re-run the job from Settings > Imports.
